kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتقد (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِدُ (ʔantaqidu) /ʔan.ta.qi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# أُنْتَقَدُ (ʔuntaqadu) /ʔun.ta.qa.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# أَنْتَقِدَ (ʔantaqida) /ʔan.ta.qi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# أُنْتَقَدَ (ʔuntaqada) /ʔun.ta.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
